subject: Re: Interview on Thu — sudden positive test; proposed alternatives
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@gmail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interview on Thu — update

Hi Hannah/Marissa —

I’m so sorry for the short notice but I just got a positive COVID PCR result after arriving at my parents’ house this morning. I’m currently isolating and won’t be able to do the scheduled live pairing session at 11:30am ET today.

I still really want to move forward — I can do one of the following if either works for the interview team:

- Complete the take-home pairing spec (attached) and submit within 24 hours, then do a 30-min follow-up call (audio-only) to walk through choices
- Record a screen-share walk-through while I solve the pairing exercise (I can provide a 20–30 min unlisted video and consent)
- Reschedule the live pairing for next week (my earliest availability is Mon/Tue after 6pm ET)

I understand this is inconvenient. I’m happy to accept a recorded option if it keeps things moving.

Thanks for understanding — Elena

Attachments: elena-pcr-result-20270603.png (image/png, 78KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@gmail.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Interview on Thu — update

Elena — thanks for flagging this and glad you’re OK. Really appreciate the options.

Hannah/Karthik/Grace — quick context: Elena is our IC4 frontend candidate (HubSpot HS-4321). She landed later this morning and just got a positive PCR; she can do a recorded screen-share walk-through with consent or submit the take-home within 24 hours + quick follow-up. She also offered to reschedule to Mon/Tue evenings.

Karthik — would you be willing to accept the recorded video + 30-min follow-up (audio is fine) instead of live pairing? If not, Grace/Hannah — do you prefer to reschedule?

If we go recorded/take-home route we should provide the take-home spec and a short consent stub for recording. I attached a draft take-home and a recording-consent note we can send.

Marissa

Attachments: REDWOOD_takehome-spec.md, recording-consent.txt

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Interview on Thu — update

All — thanks for the heads up, Elena, and glad you flagged alternatives. I can evaluate a recorded screen-share walk-through plus a 30-minute follow-up (audio) to ask clarifying Qs. Two operational notes:

1) Please confirm that Elena is comfortable with the recording being unlisted and only shared with the interview panel (we need written consent).
2) If she submits a take-home within 24 hours I’d prefer the follow-up to be synchronous so I can ask design tradeoffs live; 30 min is fine.

Grace/Hannah — if we accept recorded/video I’ll treat it as equivalent to the pairing for this stage; we’ll flag any on-site asks later. If we reschedule, please indicate earliest windows and whether we need to loop in another interviewer.

I’ll also waive the 72-hour hold for the loop — no need to delay other interviews if we can get the recording/take-home.

Karthik

Hi Elena — thanks again for letting us know and for the options. We’re fine to proceed with a recorded screen-share walk-through plus a 30-minute audio follow-up. Two quick items:

1) Please send the unlisted recording link and reply-all with the short consent text below so Karthik (and the panel) have sign-off. I’ve attached the official take-home spec in case you prefer that route but you don’t need to do both.

2) If you prefer the take-home, send it by 11:30am ET tomorrow and we’ll set a 30-minute follow-up on Friday morning; otherwise we can schedule the follow-up for the same day you submit the recording.

We’ll reimburse any incidental costs if you had to change travel because of this — Marissa will send the reimbursement form.

Safe recovery — looking forward to seeing your work.

Hannah
